POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Principles of Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Principles of Power Mechanics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Principles of Power Mechanics.

2. When learning Orthographic projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic projection.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic projection.

3. When learning Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.

4. When learning Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

6. When learning Isometric projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Isometric projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric projection.

7. When learning Suspension system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Suspension system.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Suspension system.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Suspension system.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Suspension system.

8. When learning Metalwork processes in power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork processes in power mechanics.

9. When learning ISO Thread forms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ISO Thread forms.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ISO Thread forms.
   C. Skip safety briefings for ISO Thread forms.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ISO Thread forms.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

12. When learning Braking system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Braking system.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Braking system.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Braking system.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Braking system.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Engine systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Four-stroke petrol engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Four- Stroke Petrol Engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Two-stroke petrol engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
